scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @koto/learning-engine && npm run build -w @koto/shared
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @koto/learning-engine && npm run test -w @koto/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run env -w @koto/api && npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate -w @koto/api && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:test -w @koto/api && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @koto/api && npm run build -w @koto/web
scripts.build:offline: npm run build:packages && npm run build:offline -w @koto/web && cp apps/web/dist-offline/KotoQuest.html ./KotoQuest.html
